question.text: Due diligence for a Cat III AIF should be conducted at how many levels?

answer.text: Two levels: fund level and investee company level

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.4, DD is conducted at both the fund level (operational, market, regulatory, strategy, reputational risk) AND investee company level (financial, business DD). The Trap: Only one-level DD misses one dimension. Cross-Exam Context: Echoed in Topic 10 of this exam and in XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Client memos should include both DD layers to avoid blind spots.
